description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and similarity for different expansion methods. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 2 to 22, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The first line, colored blue, is labeled “en&bn” and begins at approximately 0.17 at x=2, rises to a peak of approximately 0.33 at x=5, then declines to approximately 0.26 at x=22. The second line, colored red, is labeled “en&el” and begins at approximately 0.15 at x=2, rises to a peak of approximately 0.34 at x=5, then declines to approximately 0.24 at x=22. The third line, colored green, is labeled “en&bl” and begins at approximately 0.11 at x=2, rises to approximately 0.24 at x=6, and then remains relatively steady around 0.22 to 0.26 from x=10 to x=22.
